header: The page's plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, its regular play of 2-3 minutes: the launcher, Add ROM on
a new profile once the shader list Chrome builds behind the launcher is done (Firefox builds none there, and its line
saying so is the one waited for), Start Game once the launcher names the ROM's version (before that the option is Load
ROM, and a click opens the picker again), and the logos; then Windy's first checkpoint, started from the game's
checkpoint table as the bar's Chapters menu does (tools/shader_survey.js's startAt, a need that fails the run unless
the scene it asked for is the one playing), its cutscene skipped with L: Conker walking back along the path, away from
the stream, and then about 20 s about there: to and fro by as much each way, jumping, swinging and turning the camera.
Its waits and holds there are on the game's own clock, the 60ths it adds each frame's length to (0x800BE9AC), so every
browser walks Conker as far whatever frames it gives the game; the last step reads where Conker is (the object whose
id is 1, as func_15083E90(1) finds it). tools/play_plan_extended.json goes on to three more places, for when a longer
load: RT64: all \d+ prebuilt shaders built|once the game draws
play: (() => { const f = (a) => new Float32Array(new Uint32Array([n64r(a)]).buffer)[0]; for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) { const b = 0x800CC2D0 + i * 0x32C; if (n64r(b) && (n64r(b + 0x38) & 0xFF) === 1) return [0x14, 0x18, 0x1C].map((o) => Math.round(f(b + o))); } return null; })()
